features.title: Warrior of the stars
features.text: Solarians form weapons from stellar energy. Photon power favors damage and light, while graviton power pulls enemies around and hinders them.

features.title: Attunement
features.text: Cycle actions switch between photon and graviton. Powerful disharmony abilities leave the solarian unattuned, so they must attune again to regain those benefits.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4–4.5 → 4–5. Solar weapons and offensive stellar choices support strong martial damage.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3.5–4.5. Solar shield and defensive choices can substantially improve resilience.
ratings.support: 2–3 → 2–3.5. Selected stellar effects offer control or protection; offensive builds contribute less here.
ratings.utility: 2 → 2–3. Stellar mobility and selected abilities offer focused exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Track attunement, graviton/photon choices and positioning.
